sections.title: Synopsis
sections.markdown: Freeze sub-DPS with potent crowd-control capabilities that likes to fight up close. Eagletta has a wide area taunt that also reduces enemy attack range to 1 tile - combine this with Frost tiles limiting mobility and this effectively locks down groups of enemies. She can also Shock enemies, preventing them from acting when they wander into her vicinity and trigger Predation. Offensive utility-wise, Eagletta brings the rare Vulnerable II debuff. In terms of bossing, her baseline and top-end (V6) personal damage are solid, but middle-of-the-pack among the newer damage dealer Dolls.

sections.title: Team notes
sections.markdown: Eagletta benefits from the standard Freeze supports. With Stoop Strike and her Fixed Key 1, she can provide crowd control as a sub-DPS. Bossing utility-wise, Eagletta can apply the relatively rare Vulnerability II debuff; and at V6, she provides another source of 'increased damage taken' via External Threat.

sections.title: Build notes
sections.markdown: Freeze DPS - Attack Boost, Attack, Crit. Freeze Boost attachment set recommended. The majority of Eagletta's damage is targeted damage, so look for Pinpoint Specialization or Precision Blow main stat pieces for her Remolding Core for small optimization.
